sources.beginner: hand-calc: atom balance with the lesson-printed MW_CO2 44.009 and MW_CH4 16.043 (beginner m02-m05); carbon-inventory-explorer also editable, 3 dp
sources.intermediate: mixed: excess air and trap from the NextGen carbon-efficiency-explorer (4 and 3 dp, editable); efficiency and tuning saving from the Suite Efficiency Studio (CombustionResults.jsx, 2 and 0 dp); pinch utilities by the taught problem table (exact at 2 dp)
sources.advanced: hand-calc: CRF closed forms, weighted average, straight-line path (advanced m01-m05), all reproduced exactly; carbon-abatement-explorer measure editor also reaches the costs at 4 dp

fields.prompt_precision: Give six numbers, each to two decimals.
fields.evidence: 356000 x 1.07 x 0.995 x MW_CO2 44.009 / 1000 = 16680.0887; reproduced exactly with the lesson-printed molar mass (l02-molar-masses-from-atomic-weights.md:12). Tol 0.01 is one unit at the two decimals the prompt asks for, above the half unit a correctly rounded entry can be off.
fields.notes: The carbon-inventory-explorer (InventoryExplorer.jsx) can also be set to these flows and prints tonnes at 3 decimals (/root/wt-b5-nextgen/src/components/course/panels/carbon/carbonLab.js:226 (PRINT table), :230 (fmt = toFixed(PRINT[cls]))). No probe number matches any graded value.

fields.evidence: The panel shares one fuel state across views (EfficiencyExplorer.jsx:438 excessAirAt(o2, fuel)), so a learner who types the IGRITA fractions and slides to 6.2 reads 37.8645 at 4 decimals; tol 0.0001 is one unit in that place.

The closed form is taught (intermediate m02 l02) but the stoichiometric dry products are not printed, so a hand route is incomplete.

fields.recommendation: Display fix. The prompt asks for four decimals and tol is 0.0001; the Studio prints 85.02 (0.0016 off) and the NextGen loss view cannot be set to a 251 C stack. Loosening to 0.005 would contradict the stated four decimals.
fields.evidence: With Full precision on, the Combustion & heaters headline prints the LHV efficiency at 6 decimals (jest: efficiencyFullPrecision.test.jsx).
fields.notes: Hand route not taught to completion: m03 l01 prints the losses and the typical cp values but never writes the dry flue gas mass formula, so the full-precision value needs the engine.

shipped.suite: Suite PR #561 (Energy & Utilities Efficiency Studio Full precision switch, stacked on #554)
shipped.prompt_append: Read the figures in the Energy & Utilities Efficiency Studio with its Full precision switch on (at the top of the page): it prints them to the precision this capstone grades, with no digit grouping.

fields.prompt_precision: in GJ, to the nearest whole GJ
fields.evidence: The Studio prints the saving at 0 decimals (7,772 GJ/yr against 7771.999995); tol 1 is a whole unit at the stated precision. The NextGen TuningMode (EfficiencyExplorer.jsx:224) is pinned to the ISIOKPO fuel and temperatures (carbonLab.js:588 tuning uses heaterAt with H), so it cannot reach IGRITA.
fields.notes: Studio prints with a thousands separator (toLocaleString); the learner types 7772.

fields.prompt_precision: in tonnes a year, to two decimals
fields.evidence: Orifice 5, upstream 8.213 bar a (7.2 + 1.013, the learner adds the atmosphere as the capstone key does), Cd 0.68, density 4.28, hours 8200 are all boxes; the panel prints tonnes a year to 3 decimals (469.688). Tol 0.01 is one unit at the asked two decimals.
fields.notes: The Suite Studio prints the trap at 0 decimals (UtilitiesResults.jsx:41 fmt(trap.tonnesPerYear, 0)), which would miss by 0.31; the panel is the working source.

fields.evidence: The problem table on the four streams at 12 C is taught step by step (m05 l05) and every product is CP x interval with CPs at two decimals and whole-degree shifts, so the cascade is exact at 51.59; tol 0.01 is one unit at the asked precision.
fields.notes: The NextGen PinchMode offers only the ISIOKPO streams at 10/15/20 C (EfficiencyExplorer.jsx:369). The Suite Studio accepts the streams but prints utilities at 1 decimal (PinchResults.jsx:11 dp = 1, :50), 51.6, which sits on the tol boundary (0.01) and can fail on float noise; printing 2 decimals there would be a harmless improvement.

fields.evidence: Same problem table; the cold utility closes the balance exactly at 224.13.
fields.notes: A learner who reads the Suite Studio gets 224.1 (PinchResults.jsx:51, 1 decimal), 0.03 off and a fail; suggest fmt(pinch.coldUtilityKW, 2) at PinchResults.jsx:50-51 if the Studio is meant to be a route.
